name: Corporate Action Event Registration
definition: Specifies the official date and identification of the event.

OfficialCorporateActionEventIdentificati.name: Official Corporate Action Event Identification
OfficialCorporateActionEventIdentificati.definition: Identification of a corporate action assigned by an official central body/entity within a given market.

OfficialAnnouncementPublicationDate.name: Official Announcement Publication Date
OfficialAnnouncementPublicationDate.definition: Date/time at which the corporate action is legally announced by an official body, for example, publication by a governmental administration.

CorporateActionEvent.name: Corporate Action Event
CorporateActionEvent.definition: Corporate event for which a registration is specified.
